name: S. Abell, attorney and counsellor

partners.name: S. Abell
partners.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card abell_sidney (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

partners.name: Abell
partners.basis: The register holds this printed name as person_abell with action 'new_resident': the town does not carry a card for them under an id this record can name, so the reading is the name and not yet a person. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The paper names a street and no house on it.
locations.limit_reason: The paper names Dearborn Street and nothing narrower; the anchor 'the "Eagle Coffee House"' names nothing the committed town holds.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-06-24, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read southern: S. Abell (southern). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
